title: Senior Product Operations Manager
description:
About EarnIn 
 As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.
 We're fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We're growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.
 POSITION SUMMARY 
 As a Senior Operations and Strategy Manager, you'll help bring our mission to life. You'll shape business strategy and success from the ground up, covering customer insights, go-to-market, customer adoption, product, and operations. EarnIn is making AI-native work a core capability. It's how we design, build, and ship, not an initiative. In this role, you'll apply that to how the business runs.
 You'll operate like an early general manager: understanding business economics, defining strategy, and breaking big goals into work that gets done. As EarnIn adds business units, you may be placed where the need is greatest. You'll influence and develop the strategies for how EarnIn becomes a market leader. That includes defining new bets, incubating 0-1 experiments, scoping partnership opportunities, and executing on initiatives that drive growth and adoption. You'll be both a strategist and a builder, and you'll employ everything in your toolkit to architect strategy, discover new insights, and drive execution. Agents and AI workflows you help put in place will run in production, so they need to be fast, safe, and durable. The people who depend on EarnIn to access their pay when it matters most are the reason this work matters.
 The Mountain View base salary range for this full-time position is $153,000-$187,000, plus equity and benefits. We determine salary ranges by role, level, and location. This is a hybrid position in Mountain View that requires in-office work 2 days a week.
 What You'll Do 
 Partner with the GMs to define the vision, then own and scale this opportunity with product, sales, operations, business development, finance, and other teams. 
 Develop the roadmap and key proof points for B2B initiatives, and work with a small cross-functional team to bring the vision to life.
 Experiment quickly to drive go-to-market and customer adoption, then turn what you learn into scalable playbooks we use going forward.
 Identify where manual work in B2B go-to-market, adoption, and account operations can be replaced with agentic workflows, and partner with engineering to build them.
 Take AI pilots from experiment to production by turning what works into playbooks, templates, and reference implementations other teams can reuse.
 Take pilots that work and make them sustainable, so the next team can run them without starting over.
 Work with business development, sales, and account management on pitch decks and sales content that create new business opportunities.
 Create innovative solutions that drive growth and operational excellence, and implement product testing and roll-outs on the ground. Look at each step of how the B2B business operates and ask: why isn't an agent doing this?
 Establish and monitor performance metrics, and make results visible and trustworthy.
 Provide regular updates and reports to senior leadership, including the executive team, and build consensus to get new work done.
 What We're Looking For: 
 Bachelor's degree required. MBA or Master's degree is a plus.
 4+ years of experience in Strategy and Operations, Consulting, Customer Success, Sales, Business Development, and/or Partnerships. Experience in startups, lean business units, or product incubation teams, where you owned work end to end with limited support, is advantageous.
 Hands-on experience using AI tools or agentic workflows to automate or improve business operations, such as GTM, sales, or customer success work
 A curious, sharp, first-principles thinker who is both a strategist and a builder, comfortable with ambiguity, and energized by solving hard problems
 Experience leading cross-functional projects and hitting goals, including influencing and building alignment up to the executive level
 Comfort speaking directly with customers and partners, working with product and engineering, and managing revenue and costs
 Experience taking a pilot or experiment to a repeatable process other teams actually use
 Very strong verbal and written communication, and equal comfort interfacing internally and externally
 Strong data retrieval, analytics, and presentation skills, and comfort using data to drive decisions
 Enthusiasm for test and learn, no fear of failure, and demonstrated success in the face of roadblocks and limited resources
 A high degree of ownership, with curiosity across finance, marketing, and operations rather than staying in one lane

 SQL experience
 0-1 experience in fintech products
 Experience in fintech or regulated, security-sensitive environments
 Experience with AI governance in a regulated environment

description:

 In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way.  What You'll Do

This role owns the processes, timelines, tracking, and cross-functional coordination that allow medical strategy to be executed on time, on budget, and in compliance with company SOPs. 
 The core of the role is the interface between Medical Affairs and the budget, contracting, and procurement organization. This individual partners directly with cross-functional teams to ensure MAF activities are properly scoped, contracted, funded, tracked, and closed out. This spans MLR submissions, advisory boards, sponsorships, grants, congresses, and vendor engagements. 
 This position suits a highly organized project manager who is energized by making complex, multi-stakeholder plans happen.

 Maintain the master MAF activity calendar, including sponsorship submission windows, contracting lead times, and congress sponsorship deadlines, 
 Build and maintain a professional society sponsorship entitlement tracker maximizing sponsorship opportunities 
 Coordinate logistics for meetings with society and organization leaders on behalf of medical leadership: scheduling, agendas 
 Own congress operational execution: meeting room and workspace reservations, badge and registration management, and vendor coordination 
 Liaise with scientific communications team to help manage production, shipment, tracking, and on-site delivery of medical and booth materials, with clear ownership of quantities, timelines, and approval status 
 Serve as the operational point of contact with congress organizers, hotels, exhibit houses, AV vendors, and logistics providers 
 Assist Medical Directors with MLR submissions - compiling submission packages, routing materials, tracking review status, monitoring turnaround times, and following up to keep materials moving 
 Where You'll Work 
 This is either a hybrid role requiring in-office collaboration 2-3x per week in our San Francisco Office, or a U.S.-based remote role that will require quarterly, or as needed, visits to our San Francisco Office. 
 Travel up to 25% is expected for scientific congresses, advisory boards, company-sponsored symposia, KOL engagements, and key internal meetings.

 Excellent project management skills with a track record of managing multiple concurrent workstreams

 Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams

 Preferred 
 Experience in a rare disease, launch-stage, or high-growth biotech environment 
 Experience building or scaling Medical Affairs operational infrastructure where processes did not previously exist 
 Experience managing a sponsorship portfolio and tracking benefit realization 
 Familiarity with contract lifecycle management and MLR review platforms

title: Senior Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
At Sword, we're building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity's full potential. In doing so, we're pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need-and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.
 Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women's health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.
 AI Proficiency at Sword
 AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework - be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.
 Explorer (Level 1) - Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity
 Builder (Level 2) - Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team
 Integrator (Level 3) - Embeds AI into products and processes at scale
 Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.
 Role 
 Sword Health is looking for an exceptional go-getter to join our team as a Lifecycle Marketing Operations Specialist to own the execution and deployment of our data-driven marketing initiatives. This role requires an independent self-starter who can flawlessly deliver the baseline but also proactively seeks to improve existing processes to increase efficiency and scalability. A subject-matter-expert who can manage, build and execute against requirements from various stakeholders. Collaborating intimately across Growth, Data, Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams will be core to success.
 What you'll be doing 
 Manage day-to-day campaign production, QA, execution, reporting & optimization of marketing campaigns and programs
 Own implementation of automated journeys and blast campaigns from start to finish, across multiple channels including email, sms, push, in-app and direct mail
 Work cross-functionally with various teams, including Enrollment, Growth, Member Engagement, Content, Creative, Data, Product & Engineering to launch communications across Sword-owned channels
 Ensure that Marketing Operations standards are met, including proper naming conventions, event conversion tagging, and QA prior to campaign deployment
 Monitor and optimize multiple campaigns & programs at a time, ensuring that campaigns launch and deliver on schedule and according to expectations
 Proactively identify issues leading up to a launch and during a live campaign that would prevent campaign success, working with key stakeholders to solve and troubleshoot as necessary
 Code logic in email template to personalize content for 1:1 experience using scripting language such as Handlebars, Liquid, AMPScript, etc.
 Lead and own improvements on operational processes to improve efficiency and scalability
 Uncover hidden opportunities for the improvement of processes and data. Proactively find blockers and challenges to our growth, then take the initiative to solve them
 Collaborate with Growth & Engineering teams to ensure data pipelines are set up between marketing systems for real time data updates, event triggers, and member profile updates prior to campaign launches
 Develop and document best practices approach for gathering and analyzing data to identify key performance indicators, prioritization, and optimization strategies
 What you need to have 
 Minimum 2 year experience in Lifecycle/Marketing Operations with at least one marketing automation platform, such as Iterable, Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Cordial, Marketo, etc. (Iterable a plus, but not necessary)
 Experience in building and deploying omni-channel messaging, including email, push, SMS, in-app, direct mail
 Knowledge in HTML/CSS with experience in coding mobile-first email templates

title: Per Diem Clinical Research Nurse - Home Visits
description:
Science 37's Nursing Solutions Group brings together expert nurses who share a passion for organizing, planning and implementing mobile clinical nurse services to participants in clinical trials. Science 37's extraordinary work environment allows continuous collaboration between clinicians, clinical researchers, patient recruitment specialists, data managers and technology developers. The Nursing Solutions Group is involved throughout the trial life cycle, from protocol development and feasibility analysis to clinical trial implementation and closeout.
 The Per Diem Mobile Research Nurse is a Registered Nurse who will work per diem and has experience across multiple therapeutic areas with the ability to work independently and integrate well with the Nursing Solutions Group. With interest/expertise in Science 37's decentralized model of care delivery, the Mobile Research Nurse will perform delivery of care to participants as well as collaborate with brick and mortar sites, if indicated, for shared clinical trial implementation.  *This is a travel role that requires on-site visits to participants homes.
 Duties for this position include but are not limited to:
 Participate and provide research nurse services to qualified study participants at home
 Apply clinical research and nursing practices to develop solutions to complex problems
 Collaborate with Lead and Per Diem Mobile Research Nurses on solutioning, education, and resource support
 Participate in activities that will further the operational development of Science 37 nursing service delivery
 Develop relationships with study team members and serve as the subject matter expert (SME) on all nursing processes
 Other duties as assigned as the needs of Science 37 evolve and change
 This position has the following qualifications:
 BSN degree preferred
 Full Covid Vaccination strongly preferred. Science 37 follows CDC guidelines for vaccination recommendations and such guidelines are subject to change.
 Active RN licensure in home state as well as eligibility for Compact Licensure required

 Basic Life Support (BLS) Certification

 Active Driver's License

title: Technical Program Manager
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring Technical Program Managers to join our Technical Program Management team. 
 Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves-one that behaves like a doctor in the family.
 About the role: 
 Help turn ambitious plans into better healthcare experiences through technology.
 Oscar is hiring three Technical Program Managers to join our growing Technology Program Management Office (Tech PMO). By applying to this job post, you will be considered for all Technical Program Manager openings. Specific role placement will be determined following the interview process.
 As a Technical Program Manager, you will lead work that helps members navigate their coverage, providers work more easily with Oscar, clinical teams deliver better care, and grow our business. We're looking for someone who brings curiosity, initiative, and sound judgment. You enjoy understanding how systems work, asking thoughtful questions, and finding a path forward when the answer isn't obvious. You build trust across teams, make difficult tradeoffs clear, and follow through on the details that turn a good plan into a successful launch.
 You'll partner with Product, Engineering, and business leaders across our Network, Growth, Member, and Clinical pillars. Each hire will support a defined set of teams, combining visibility across their roadmaps with direct leadership of selected complex programs. Your work could span provider data platforms, clinical integrations, member digital experiences, enrollment, broker tools, or marketing technology.
 As an early member of a growing Tech PMO, you'll also help shape how we plan, solve problems, and deliver together. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director of the Tech PMO.
 You will report into the Director, Technical Program Management.
 Work Location: 
 This position is based in our New York City office, requiring a hybrid work schedule with 3 days of in-office work per week. Thursdays are a required in-office day for team meetings and events, while your other two office days are flexible to suit your schedule. #LI-Hybrid
 Pay Transparency: 
 The base pay for this role is: $117,576.00 - $154,318.50 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program, and annual performance bonuses.
 Responsibilities: 
 Lead complex technical programs from scoping through launch and operational handoff. Build integrated plans with clear owners, milestones, dependencies, and measures of success.
 Turn ambiguity into action. Bring the right people together, clarify the problem, and establish practical next steps.
 Partner with Product, Engineering, and business leaders to connect roadmaps, coordinate commitments, and make scope, sequencing, and capacity tradeoffs explicit.
 Anticipate delivery risks and resolve dependency gaps. Drive timely decisions and escalate with clear options, recommendations, and business impact.
 Coordinate teams and vendors through integrations, testing, adoption, and launch readiness, including required security, privacy, and compliance reviews.
 Support quarterly and annual planning. Give leaders a clear view of progress, what needs attention, and whether delivered work is producing the intended results.
 Help build a strong TPM team: share useful practices, challenge unnecessary process, support colleagues, and turn lessons from delivery into improvements.
 Requirements: 
 Experience independently leading complex technical programs across multiple teams, from planning through launch and operational handoff.
 Technical fluency to engage engineers on software systems, APIs, data flows, integrations, and implementation tradeoffs.
 Demonstrated ability to bring structure to ambiguous problems and manage dependencies, risks, and competing priorities.
 A record of building trust and influencing decisions across technical and business teams without direct authority.
 Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain complex issues and recommend a course of action to senior leaders.
 Strong ownership and follow-through, with examples of moving work forward when plans change or obstacles arise.
 Bonus points: 
 Experience in healthcare, health insurance, or another regulated industry.
 Experience in one or more relevant areas: provider platforms, clinical systems, consumer digital products, enrollment, broker or distribution platforms, or marketing technology.
 Experience with external vendors, platform migrations, or complex system integrations.
 Experience improving planning and delivery practices or helping teams adopt new tools and ways of working.
 Experience delivering AI-enabled products or workflow automation, including evaluation and operational readiness.
 This is an authentic Oscar Health job opportunity. 
 At Oscar, being an Equal Opportunity Employer means more than upholding discrimination-free hiring practices. It means that we cultivate an environment where people can be their most authentic selves and find both belonging and support. We're on a mission to change health care -- an experience made whole by our unique backgrounds and perspectives.

Full-time employees are eligible for benefits including: medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, paid sick time, paid parental leave, 401(k) plan participation, life and disability insurance, and paid wellness time and reimbursements.

Any Oscar applicant who requires reasonable accommodations during the application process should contact the Oscar Benefits Team (accommodations@hioscar.com) to make the need for an accommodation known.

title: Operations Manager - London Sort Centre
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe's largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen
Relay's Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.
THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‐principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation
The Opportunity
You will report to the Site Manager/Head of Site and will run shifts at one of our Hybrid Sort Centres (HSCs), leading 50-100+ operatives through high-volume, time-pressured sortation where minutes matter and small deviations cascade into missed deadlines. Each of our HSCs handle over 40 million parcels annually, with our largest site measuring more than 300,000 sq ft.
You will also be accountable for whether the site is measurably better in a month than it is today for each of our key metrics. You are on the floor for your shift, every shift. This is not a project role with occasional site visits and it is not a desk job, the forward work happens along with running the operation.
Who will thrive in this role
 - Deliver shift plan end to end people deployment, throughput, quality standards, and health & safety compliance
 - Lead, develop, and performance-manage a frontline team of 50-100+ operatives
 - Build the mechanisms that hold the operation together. Build controls, cadences, metrics, SOPs, change management and own their adoption, not only their design
 - Plan ahead for future shifts; labour, training, and the risks you can see coming before they land
 - Own the end-of-shift handover; what happened, what is at risk, what the next shift needs to know
 - Stay decisive through volume peaks, outages, and labour gaps. Triage, solve the problem at hand quickly, contain the impact, restore flow
 - Present and write clearly whether briefs, escalations, handovers or post-incident reviews. Decisions here get made based off what you wrote
 - Implement changes into a live operation such as introducing robotics, launching new sortation tech or onboarding new clients. We are changing the operations constantly which means you'll roll change out mid flight and bring your team along the journey.
Who you are
 - Scaled something from zero: a site, a market, a process or a program.
 - Managed a physical operation: quick commerce, grocery, e-commerce fulfillment, last mile, 3PL, food production, airport ground handling, rail. Anywhere with a hard cut off and people on the floor.
 - Communicate in both directions and have strong people management skills: you can brief 80 operatives at shift start and take a problem to senior leadership the same day.
 - Built a mechanism that held: a control, a cadence, a metric, a document standard. Something you authored that changed how frontline teams worked.
 - Own numbers rather than report them: you can name a metric you created or redefined, explain why the previous one was wrong, and say what changed afterwards.
 - Understand frontline work: one of these must be true: you have personally led frontline teams; you have worked embedded in and around a frontline population day to day, without the reporting line; or you have been accountable for outcomes delivered by frontline people you did not employ.
You do not need to have worked in parcels, fulfilment, or sortation. Several of our most talented people had not.
Backgrounds that translate well
 - Program Manager in a logistics or e-commerce business
 - Operations Excellence and Continuous Improvement
 - Strategy & Operations
 - Transformation manager
 - Launch and Expansion Manager
 - Regional operations manager
We have hired well from corporate operations, from central operations inside large UK retailers and carriers, and from quick commerce and marketplace operators. Consulting backgrounds work where you implemented, not only recommended; we are keen to understand what you who actually rolled it out.
Hiring process
Our hiring process is fast.
 - Initial screen (15 min)
 - Hiring Manager conversation (90 min) - 45 min onsite interview immediately followed by a 45 min site tour where you shadow an existing shift manager
 - Final interview (45 min). Decision and offer within 48 hours
Who Thrives at Relay?
 - Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.
 - Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.
 - 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.
 - All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.
 - People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.
 - Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.
 If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let's connect.
Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

 - Own the end-of-shift handover; what happened, what is at risk, what the next shift needs to know
 - Stay decisive through volume peaks, outages, and labour gaps. Triage, solve the problem at hand quickly, contain the impact, restore flow
 - Present and write clearly whether briefs, escalations, handovers or post-incident reviews. Decisions here get made based off what you wrote
 - Implement changes into a live operation such as introducing robotics, launching new sortation tech or onboarding new clients. We are changing the operations constantly which means you'll roll change out mid flight and bring your team along the journey.
Who you are
 - Scaled something from zero: a site, a market, a process or a program.
 - Managed a physical operation: quick commerce, grocery, e-commerce fulfillment, last mile, 3PL, food production, airport ground handling, rail. Anywhere with a hard cut off and people on the floor.
 - Communicate in both directions and have strong people management skills: you can brief 80 operatives at shift start and take a problem to senior leadership the same day.
 - Built a mechanism that held: a control, a cadence, a metric, a document standard. Something you authored that changed how frontline teams worked.
 - Own numbers rather than report them: you can name a metric you created or redefined, explain why the previous one was wrong, and say what changed afterwards.
 - Understand frontline work: one of these must be true: you have personally led frontline teams; you have worked embedded in and around a frontline population day to day, without the reporting line; or you have been accountable for outcomes delivered by frontline people you did not employ.
You do not need to have worked in parcels, fulfilment, or sortation. Several of our most talented people had not.
Backgrounds that translate well
 - Program Manager in a logistics or e-commerce business
 - Operations Excellence and Continuous Improvement
 - Strategy & Operations
 - Transformation manager
 - Launch and Expansion Manager
 - Regional operations manager
We have hired well from corporate operations, from central operations inside large UK retailers and carriers, and from quick commerce and marketplace operators. Consulting backgrounds work where you implemented, not only recommended; we are keen to understand what you who actually rolled it out.
Hiring process
Our hiring process is fast.
 - Initial screen (15 min)
 - Hiring Manager conversation (90 min) - 45 min onsite interview immediately followed by a 45 min site tour where you shadow an existing shift manager
 - Final interview (45 min). Decision and offer within 48 hours
Who Thrives at Relay?
 - Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.
 - Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.
 - 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.
 - All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.
 - People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.
 - Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.
 If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let's connect.
Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Marketplace Operations Manager II
description:
Job Title: Marketplace Operations Manager II 
 Job Location (Remote): Remote, USA
 About the Company 
 Wheel is evolving the traditional care ecosystem by equipping the nation's most innovative companies with a premier platform to deliver high-quality virtual care at scale. We offer proven strategies and cutting-edge technologies to foster consumer engagement, build brand loyalty, and maximize return on investment. Wheel solutions include configurable virtual care programs, an intuitive consumer interface, and access to a nationwide network of board-certified clinicians. Discover how Wheel is transforming the future of healthcare by visiting www.wheel.com .
 About the Role 
 We're looking for a Marketplace Operations Manager II to own visit delivery for a defined set of Wheel's client programs. This is an operator's role for someone who wants day-to-day ownership of critical business outcomes - and can carry that accountability even when some levers live with peer functions. You'll take on the complex, ambiguous problems that come with scaling a fast-growing telehealth marketplace - from stabilizing a roster through demand volatility, to leading cross-functional projects that shape how Marketplace Operations scales next.
 You will own the visit delivery SLA commitments, program-level consult cost performance, and the roster health for your clients. Separate functions on the team own overall clinician supply forecasting, clinician performance management, and scheduling - freeing you up to optimize their use within your programs.
 This is a role for someone who wants to run marketplace operations for key clients end-to-end: launching and configuring new client programs, writing the operational playbooks your programs run on, and deploying incentive spend within guardrails - while trusting peer functions to own adjacent responsibilities in order for you to maintain a singular, maniacal focus on client performance.
 What You'll Do 
 Program Performance and Delivery 
 Own marketplace performance outcomes (contractual and otherwise) for your assigned client programs: SLA attainment, program-level clinician pay cost, and roster/staffing health.
 Own roster composition and staffing strategy for your programs, building and adjusting rosters to ensure SLA through client growth, churn, and short-term volatility.
 Own operational data analytics and reporting for your programs - pulling and interrogating utilization, breach-pattern, and profitability data yourself and turning it into recommendations and actions
 Own the operating rhythm and upward performance visibility for your programs: recurring performance reviews of SLA, utilization, and cost that turns into actions.
 Partner with the Capacity Planner to understand near-term volatility and how it may affect client demand (ie demand surges, modality changes, etc) and own the operational response for your programs (escalation thresholds, incentive levers, roster mix) to keep the program on track.
 Cost and Incentives 
 Optimize program-level clinician pay cost and deploy consult incentive spend within a defined budget.
 Own the cost plan for your programs and be accountable to variance - partner with the Director of Marketplace on expected cost-per-consult, and keep your lever costs calibrated so you know how to deploy your incentives appropriately.
 Real-Time Response and Agent Oversight 
 Author the real-time escalation and response playbook your programs run on: thresholds, approved corrective actions, escalation triggers. Real-time monitoring and AI agents execute against the playbook you write, and you refine how they act on your programs as their capabilities grow.
 Review how the agents act on your programs - audit their decisions for quality, catch policy drift or mistakes early, and feed corrections back into the playbook and the agent logic. You're the human-in-the-loop that keeps automated responses trustworthy on your book.
 Partner with clinician management peers to relay clinician performance observations that impact your programs and to identify roster improvements that will drive your client performance.
 Client Launches and Partnership 
 Partner with Customer Success as the operational counterpart on the client's commercial relationship - supporting quarterly business reviews and the real-world story behind client performance.
 Own launch supply-readiness with Provider Operations and the Capacity Planner - ensuring clinicians are credentialed, licensed, and activated in the right states, at the volume the program needs, before go-live.
 Lead new-client implementation - configuration and setup - as part of cross functional onboarding teams, and own expansions for programs you already run.
 Support strategic projects across Marketplace Operations as they arise.
 Who You Are 
 An operator with experience working in fast-paced, high-demand environments - someone who digs into the details to find root cause, spots broken or inefficient processes, and builds the fix rather than just flagging the problem.
 Experience owning end-to-end operational performance in a marketplace, logistics, or two-sided platform environment (delivery, rideshare, staffing, workforce management) - direct accountability for SLA, throughput, or cost.
 Strategic thinker who connects day-to-day program performance to the bigger picture - you can zoom out from a single roster or escalation to spot the pattern worth fixing structurally, and zoom back in to execute it.
 A strong cross-functional partner and team player - you know how to work through peer teams and different personalities to drive your program's outcomes, even when you don't own every lever yourself.
 Strong data fluency. You pull and interrogate your own SLA, completion, utilization, and cost-to-plan data and drive decisions from it - hands-on with SQL, Looker, and Excel - rather than waiting for someone to translate it for you.
 A direct, clear communicator who authors and revises the procedures your programs run on - escalation playbooks, response plans, launch runbooks - rather than only following ones someone else wrote.
 Nice to Have
 Don't let these stand in your way-they're just added bonuses! If you meet most of the core requirements, we encourage you to apply. 
 Exposure to multi-state licensure, credentialing, or other regulated-workforce dynamics.
 Experience launching or configuring new client programs in a marketplace or platform business.
 Healthcare, telehealth, or regulated-workforce experience.
 Marketplace or platform experience.
 Salary and Perks
 Pay Range: $122,075- $155,000 plus equity
 Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate's work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations. 
 Wheel is unable to consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.
 As an employee of Wheel, you'll enjoy our Total Rewards Program to help secure your financial future and preserve your health and well-being, including:
 Medical, Dental and Vision
 Ancillary: Life, Short and Long Term Disability
 401K match
 Flexible PTO
 Parental Leave
 Stock options
 Additional programs and perks
 Wheel is committed to equal employment opportunities for all team members. Every decision we make regarding employment is solely based on merit, competence, and performance. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.
 Research shows that underrepresented groups typically apply only if they meet 100% of the criteria listed. At Wheel, we encourage women, people of color, and LGBTQ+ job seekers to apply for positions even if they don't check every box for the role.

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description:
Since inception, Elation has been focused on building a delightful, world-class experience that empowers physicians to deliver phenomenal care to patients. Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through our SaaS cloud-based clinical platform.
 As we continue to scale, we are growing our Customer Success organization to meet the needs of our most strategic customers. We are seeking an experienced, senior-level Customer Success Manager to own and grow a portfolio of innovative healthcare delivery organizations.
 What You'll Do 
 Strategic Account Ownership Serve as the trusted strategic advisor and primary point of contact for a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise healthcare customers. Build deep executive relationships, understand each organization's clinical and operational goals, and position Elation as a long-term platform partner.
 Strategic Account Planning Develop and execute comprehensive, multi-stakeholder account plans aligned to each customer's business objectives. Drive measurable platform adoption, value realization, and long-term partnership growth.
 Executive Engagement & Value Delivery Lead high-impact Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) with senior clinical and operational leadership. Deliver data-driven ROI narratives and strategic roadmaps that reinforce Elation's value and deepen executive sponsorship.
 Renewal Management Own the full renewal lifecycle - from strategic planning and executive alignment to contract negotiation and timely close. Maintain a strong, predictable renewal rate across your book of business.
 Strategic Expansion & Whitespace Management Act as the primary commercial lead for your portfolio, directly driving and executing the end-to-end sales cycle for all cross-sell and upsell transactions. You will proactively pursue and close whitespace opportunities by translating usage data, clinical workflows, and organizational growth signals into prioritized expansion strategies that result in realized revenue and increased account penetration.
 Proactive Risk Mitigation Monitor customer health signals and leverage AI-driven insights to identify at-risk accounts early. Develop and execute tailored mitigation plans to address risk and protect long-term retention.
 Product Adoption & Utilization Drive deep feature adoption across your portfolio through targeted campaigns and high-impact interventions. Partner with product and clinical teams to ensure customers are maximizing the full value of the Elation platform.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner closely with Implementation, Professional Services, Sales, and Technical Support to deliver a seamless, world-class customer journey from onboarding through renewal and beyond.
 Consultative Selling Act as a consultative partner - identifying evolving customer needs and effectively presenting the value of Elation Health 's expanding suite of products and services.
 What You Bring 
 Experience 
 5+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a customer-facing growth role, with at least 2+ years focused on mid-market and enterprise accounts in healthcare SaaS, EHR, or RCM platforms
 Demonstrated success managing complex, multi-stakeholder accounts and navigating large healthcare organizations
 Prior experience owning expansion revenue, renewals, and upsell/cross-sell motions within an existing book of business
 Familiarity with ambulatory, specialty, multi-site group practices, or enterprise health systems
 Skills & Competencies 
 Executive presence and the ability to influence and build trust with C-suite and VP-level stakeholders
 Strong full-cycle, consultative selling instincts - comfortable identifying needs, building business cases, and presenting solutions
 Proficiency in data storytelling: translating platform usage, outcomes data, and ROI metrics into compelling customer narratives
 Skilled in clinical use case framing to connect platform capabilities to physician and operational workflows
 Experience with lifecycle automation tools, CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce), and customer health monitoring solutions
 Mindset 
 Strategic thinker who balances long-term relationship building with near-term revenue accountability
 Proactive, organized, and comfortable managing a complex book of business with competing priorities
 Collaborative and cross-functional by nature - you thrive working with sales, product, and services teams
 How We Measure Success 
 Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and Gross Revenue Retention (GRR)
 Expansion and upsell pipeline and close rate
 Renewal rate and on-time renewal %
 Platform adoption and utilization metrics across portfolio
 Executive engagement and EBR completion rate
 Proactive outreach and health score improvement across at-risk accounts
 Salary: $105,000 - 120,000/yr USD w/ variable comp 
 Elation welcomes individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life. Elation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is dedicated to creating and maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment.
 We are committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, and value individuals with diverse perspectives including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status.
 Elation also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. We firmly believe a strong culture that supports a diverse and inclusive workforce allows us to achieve Elation's mission of helping independent primary care thrive.

title: Sales Operations Analyst
description:
Ironclad is the leading AI contracting platform that transforms agreements into assets. Contracts move faster, insights surface instantly, and agents push work forward, all with you in control. Whether you're buying or selling, Ironclad unifies the entire process on one intelligent platform, providing leaders with the visibility they need to stay one step ahead. That's why the world's most transformative organizations, from Rivian to the World Health Organization and the Associated Press, trust Ironclad to accelerate their business.
We're consistently recognized as a leader in the industry: a Leader in the Forrester Wave and Gartner Magic Quadrant for Contract Lifecycle Management, a Fortune Great Place to Work, and one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Workplaces. Ironclad has also been named to Forbes' AI 50 and Business Insider's list of Companies to Bet Your Career On. We're backed by leading investors including Accel, Y Combinator, Sequoia, BOND, and Franklin Templeton. For more information, visit www.ironcladapp.com http://www.ironcladapp.com or follow us on LinkedIn.
Reporting to our Director of Sales Operations, the Sales Operations Analyst will be a key strategic partner to Sales and GTM leadership, owning the analytics, planning, and operating cadence that power our revenue engine. This role will center on deep pipeline and performance insights, building and maintaining models that guide capacity, coverage, segmentation, and forecast accuracy. The Sales Operations Analyst will also own a disciplined operating cadence, driving regular reviews across segments and sales motions to keep leadership aligned and accountable. The ideal candidate will blend strong analytical rigor with cross-functional collaboration, leveraging AI-assisted forecasting and modern GTM tooling to translate complex trends into clear, actionable recommendations that improve pipeline generation, conversion, and overall revenue performance.
This is a hybrid role based out of our San Francisco office. Office attendance is required twice a week for collaboration and connection. There may be additional in-office days for team or company events.
What You'll Be Doing:
 - Act as a strategic partner to Sales and GTM leadership, developing a deep understanding of the business to identify opportunities to improve pipeline generation, conversion, and revenue performance. Translate insights into clear recommendations that drive measurable outcomes.
 - Own pipeline and performance insights, including understanding pipeline composition (inbound, outbound, partner, expansion) and proactively identifying risks and opportunities across stages, segments, and use cases.
 - Build and maintain analytical models (capacity, pipeline coverage, attainment, segmentation, territory design) to inform both near-term execution and long-range planning.
 - Leverage modern data and AI tools to accelerate analysis, uncover insights, and improve decision-making across GTM. Continuously evaluate new tools and approaches to increase team efficiency and analytical depth.
 - Drive operating cadence and execution rigor, including forecast support, pipeline inspection, and business reviews to ensure consistency, accountability, and high-quality data across the organization.
 - Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Systems, and GTM teams to align on planning, performance tracking, and process improvements that support scalable growth.
 - Lead key planning initiatives, including annual planning, territory design, and quota setting.
 - Continuously improve systems, processes, and data quality, working closely with GTM Systems to ensure tools (e.g., Salesforce, forecasting platforms) effectively support the sales motion and evolving business needs.
What We're Looking For:
 - 4+ years of experience in Sales Strategy, Revenue Operations, Management Consulting, or a related analytical role in a high-growth SaaS environment.
 - Strong analytical and modeling skills, with experience building and interpreting models related to sales capacity, pipeline, forecasting, and revenue performance.
 - Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into clear insights and executive-level recommendations that influence decision-making.
 - Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, and Systems teams in a fast-paced, scaling organization.
 - Familiarity with core GTM systems and tools (e.g., Salesforce, BI platforms such as Looker, and modern sales tooling).
 - Comfort leveraging AI and advanced analytics tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Glean, Actively or similar platforms) to enhance productivity, accelerate insights, and improve decision-making. Curiosity and willingness to experiment with new tools is highly valued.
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with senior leadership and drive alignment across stakeholders.
 - Deep understanding of the SaaS business model, including pipeline dynamics, sales motions, and key performance drivers.
 - Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Base Salary Range: $116,000 - $145,000
The base salary range represents the minimum and maximum of the salary range for this position based at our San Francisco headquarters. The actual base salary offered for this position will depend on numerous factors, including individual proficiency, anticipated performance, and the location of the selected candidate. Our base salary is just one component of Ironclad's competitive total rewards package, which also includes equity awards (a new hire grant, along with opportunities for additional awards throughout your tenure), competitive health and wellness benefits, and a commitment to career growth and development.
US Full-Time Employee Benefits at Ironclad:
 - 100% health coverage for employees (medical, dental, and vision), and 75% coverage for dependents with buy-up plan options available
 - Market-leading leave policies, including gender-neutral parental leave and compassionate leave
 - Family forming support through Maven for you and your partner
 - Paid time off - take the time you need, when you need it
 - Monthly stipends for wellbeing, hybrid work, and (if applicable) cell phone use
 - Mental health support through Modern Health, including therapy, coaching, and digital tools
 - Pre-tax commuter benefits (US Employees)
 - 401(k) plan with Fidelity with employer match (US Employees)
 - Regular team events to connect, recharge, and have fun
 - And most importantly: the opportunity to help build the company you want to work at
**UK Employee-specific benefits are included on our UK job postings

title: Senior Manager, Account Manager, Enterprise
location: New York, NY (HQ); San Francisco, CA; Remote (US)
description:
ABOUT RAMP
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you've built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.
ABOUT THE ROLE 
In this role, you will be a front-line manager to a group of Account Managers who are responsible for hunting, pitching, and expanding the existing customer base at Ramp.
You'll lead a group of 6-8 Account Managers, each carrying a book of 60-70 Enterprise customers with real latitude over how they grow it. title: Associate Consultant - Entry-Level Clinical Data Technology Consulting
description:
Veeva's Consultant Development Program (CDP) is an accelerated pathway that transforms early-career professionals into high-impact consultants who deliver cloud and AI solutions, helping global Life Sciences companies bring life-changing therapies to patients.
The Role
You'll work hands-on with innovative Clinical Data Management technology, collaborating directly with internal teams and external customers to design, configure, and implement our clinical data software. In this role, you'll learn our industry-leading clinical trial cloud platforms and work with cutting-edge AI solutions to transform how life sciences companies manage clinical trial data. Empowered from day one by a team-first culture, you will accelerate your career growth as a technical consultant who thrives in an environment where we work hard for our customers and each other.
The Program As part of the Consultant Development Program, you will:
 Ramp up quickly: Your journey begins with an intensive, team-based onboarding program that combines hands-on learning, transparent feedback, and active collaboration to develop the consulting skills and industry knowledge to make an impact right away.
 Learn by doing: You won't be watching from the sidelines. You will take on real responsibility and work directly with customers to solve clinical data management problems within your first three months.
 Thrive together: Grow alongside a supportive team of seasoned leaders and peers who actively champion your development through open communication and actionable feedback.
 Build your future: Advance from Associate to Consultant in less than 2 years. More importantly, you'll develop the foundation for a successful, long-term career where you can continually expand your technical expertise, lead complex projects, and evolve with our global and diverse team.
What You'll Do As part of our Professional Services team, you are a strategic partner guiding clinical operations and data management teams through implementation. We will teach you how our CDMS software works, and you will use that knowledge to design, configure, and deliver solutions that drive real business value]. Your day-to-day will involve:
 Designing & tailoring the software: You will lead the configuration of our Vault CDMS platform to fit each customer's unique clinical trial requirements-setting up study workflows, structuring clinical data models, and aligning system capabilities to study protocols.
 Conducting discovery workshops: You will lead interactive discovery workshops with customer stakeholders (e.g., Clinical Data Managers, CRCs, CRAs) to gather business requirements, map out existing data management workflows, and translate their vision into actionable technical specifications.
 . Managing project scope & execution: You will take ownership of core implementation deliverables by scoping study requirements, building timeline estimates, and keeping project milestones on track from study design through go-live.
 Guiding the customer as an expert: You will lead the customer with best practices to ensure their clinical data collection and study management processes are optimized for maximum long-term value.
What We Are Looking For | We are open to graduates of a variety of backgrounds and look for a specific mindset: Education & Preferred Background 
 A Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative or life science field is preferred, such as:
 Biomedical Engineering, Health Informatics, Bioinformatics, Biostatistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering
 Clinical Research, Public Health, Biology, Pharmacology
 Desired Experience 
 Prior experience (internships, co-ops, academic projects, or entry-level roles) in one or more of the following areas is highly valued:
 Data entry or management in a healthcare/research setting, or experience at a CRO, as a Clinical Research Associate (CRA), or Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC)
 Clinical trial operations, monitoring, or clinical data management
 Data analysis using statistical software (SAS, SPSS, Python, R)
 Design training, UX Design, or Human Factors Studies
 Business or technical consulting
 Speech and Debate or Manufacturing
 Technical Skills & Mindset 
 Technical Familiarity: Basic familiarity with database concepts. For example, SQL for querying relational databases and Python or R for data manipulation and analysis
 Drive: You thrive in a challenging, intense environment that rewards initiative and rapid learning
 Curiosity: You have a genuine desire to be hands-on with software and master new technologies
 Communication: You are fluent in English with excellent verbal and written communication skills
 Analytical Mindset: You are a strong critical thinker with a proven track record of analytical performance
 Integrity: Veeva is a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) and a “do the right thing” company, and we expect that from all employees
 Work Ethic: A commitment to excellence and passion for working hard to achieve results
 Travel: Willingness to travel as needed (up to 20-30% of the time)
 Experience: Open to recent graduates of Bachelor's or Master's programs (up to 2 years postgraduate experience maximum)
How We Hire | Our process is different from most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps: Apply: Submit your resume, a short cover letter, and take a quick personality test.
 Fast Response: We will notify you of your next step typically within one week.
 Interview & Case: Interview with a Veeva leader. If successful, we will give you a real-world scenario (with 3 days to prepare) to present to our team.
 Offer: We make decisions quickly-usually within a week of your final presentation.
What We Offer Starting Annual Salary : 37,000 EUR
 Perform well, and in one year you'll receive a compensation increase and participate in our bonus program
Hybrid Work Environment: We require Associate Consultants to live within reasonable commuting distance from Veeva's Barcelona office giving you easy access to in-person collaboration and support, skill development, and social opportunities as you launch your career. Long-term, our Work Anywhere policy allows you flexibility to work from the office or from your home.
Work Authorization: Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the European Union. Veeva does not provide sponsorship for employment visa status for this employment position.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at talent_accommodations@veeva.com.

title: Medical Science Liaison - Rare Disease
description:
POSITION SUMMARY: 
 The Medical Science Liaison (MSL), Rare Disease is a field-based scientific expert and a key scientific resource for clinicians, academic institutions, and professional organizations in the Rare Disease community. This individual builds relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), leads scientific exchange on Natera's Rare Disease test, and brings field insights back to Rare Disease leadership. The MSL works closely with the Rare Disease Sales, Marketing, and Medical teams to help bring the test to more patients. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy and reports to the Director of MSLs, Rare Disease.
 PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

title: Associate Consultant - Entry-Level Clinical Data Technology Consulting
description:
Veeva's Consultant Development Program (CDP) is an accelerated pathway that transforms early-career professionals into high-impact consultants who deliver cloud and AI solutions, helping global Life Sciences companies bring life-changing therapies to patients.
The Role
You'll work hands-on with innovative Clinical Data Management technology, collaborating directly with internal teams and external customers to design, configure, and implement our clinical data software. In this role, you'll learn our industry-leading clinical trial cloud platforms and work with cutting-edge AI solutions to transform how life sciences companies manage clinical trial data. Empowered from day one by a team-first culture, you will accelerate your career growth as a technical consultant who thrives in an environment where we work hard for our customers and each other.
The Program As part of the Consultant Development Program, you will:
 Ramp up quickly: Your journey begins with an intensive, team-based onboarding program that combines hands-on learning, transparent feedback, and active collaboration to develop the consulting skills and industry knowledge to make an impact right away.
 Learn by doing: You won't be watching from the sidelines. You will take on real responsibility and work directly with customers to solve clinical data management problems within your first three months.
 Thrive together: Grow alongside a supportive team of seasoned leaders and peers who actively champion your development through open communication and actionable feedback.
 Build your future: Advance from Associate to Consultant in less than 2 years. More importantly, you'll develop the foundation for a successful, long-term career where you can continually expand your technical expertise, lead complex projects, and evolve with our global and diverse team.
What You'll Do As part of our Professional Services team, you are a strategic partner guiding clinical operations and data management teams through implementation. We will teach you how our CDMS software works, and you will use that knowledge to design, configure, and deliver solutions that drive real business value]. Your day-to-day will involve:
 Designing & tailoring the software: You will lead the configuration of our Vault CDMS platform to fit each customer's unique clinical trial requirements-setting up study workflows, structuring clinical data models, and aligning system capabilities to study protocols.
 Conducting discovery workshops: You will lead interactive discovery workshops with customer stakeholders (e.g., Clinical Data Managers, CRCs, CRAs) to gather business requirements, map out existing data management workflows, and translate their vision into actionable technical specifications.
 . Managing project scope & execution: You will take ownership of core implementation deliverables by scoping study requirements, building timeline estimates, and keeping project milestones on track from study design through go-live.
 Guiding the customer as an expert: You will lead the customer with best practices to ensure their clinical data collection and study management processes are optimized for maximum long-term value.
What We Are Looking For | We are open to graduates of a variety of backgrounds and look for a specific mindset: Education & Preferred Background 
 A Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative or life science field is preferred, such as:
 Biomedical Engineering, Health Informatics, Bioinformatics, Biostatistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering
 Clinical Research, Public Health, Biology, Pharmacology
 Desired Experience 
 Prior experience (internships, co-ops, academic projects, or entry-level roles) in one or more of the following areas is highly valued:
 Data entry or management in a healthcare/research setting, or experience at a CRO, as a Clinical Research Associate (CRA), or Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC)
 Clinical trial operations, monitoring, or clinical data management
 Data analysis using statistical software (SAS, SPSS, Python, R)
 Design training, UX Design, or Human Factors Studies
 Business or technical consulting
 Speech and Debate or Manufacturing
 Technical Skills & Mindset 
 Technical Familiarity: Basic familiarity with database concepts. For example, SQL for querying relational databases and Python or R for data manipulation and analysis
 Drive: You thrive in a challenging, intense environment that rewards initiative and rapid learning
 Curiosity: You have a genuine desire to be hands-on with software and master new technologies
 Communication: You are fluent in English with excellent verbal and written communication skills
 Analytical Mindset: You are a strong critical thinker with a proven track record of analytical performance
 Integrity: Veeva is a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) and a “do the right thing” company, and we expect that from all employees
 Work Ethic: A commitment to excellence and passion for working hard to achieve results
 Travel: Willingness to travel as needed (up to 20-30% of the time)
 Experience: Open to recent graduates of Bachelor's or Master's programs (up to 2 years postgraduate experience maximum)
How We Hire | Our process is different from most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps: Apply: Submit your resume, a short cover letter, and take a quick personality test.
 Fast Response: We will notify you of your next step typically within one week.
 Interview & Case: Interview with a Veeva leader. If successful, we will give you a real-world scenario (with 3 days to prepare) to present to our team.
 Offer: We make decisions quickly-usually within a week of your final presentation.
What We Offer Starting Annual Salary: 40,000 GBP
 Perform well, and in one year you'll receive a compensation increase and participate in our bonus program.
Hybrid Work Environment: We require Associate Consultants to live within reasonable commuting distance from Veeva's London office giving you easy access to in-person collaboration and support, skill development, and social opportunities as you launch your career. Long-term, our Work Anywhere policy allows you flexibility to work from the office or from your home.

title: Senior Program Manager, Revenue Operations
description:
About the Job: 
 LaunchDarkly is looking for a Senior Program Manager to help the Revenue Operations team scale efficiently. This role drives cross-functional programs, streamlines processes, and delivers data-driven solutions that accelerate predictable SaaS revenue growth. You'll be the person who turns strategic priorities into structured plans, keeps cross-functional teams aligned, and makes sure risks and blockers get surfaced and resolved before they slow the business down.
 The mission of the Senior Program Manager is to enable the Revenue Operations team to scale efficiently by driving cross-functional programs, streamlining processes, and delivering data-driven solutions that accelerate predictable SaaS revenue growth.
 Responsibilities:
 Drive Strategic RevOps Initiatives 
 Translate strategic priorities into structured program plans
 Define milestones, owners, and deliverables
 Track progress and outcomes against plan
 Manage dependencies and escalate blockers as needed
 Establish Program Governance & Cadences 
 Establish operating rhythms for cross-functional programs
 Run status and steering meetings
 Maintain decision and action logs
 Standardize reporting across programs
 Manage Cross-Functional Alignment 
 Coordinate across RevOps and Field (Sales, CS, Marketing) teams
 Clarify roles and responsibilities across program stakeholders
 Align teams on priorities and timelines
 Facilitate decisions and communicate updates to stakeholders and leadership
 Manage Risks, Issues & Dependencies 
 Identify risks early and maintain risk logs
 Develop mitigation plans
 Resolve cross-functional dependencies
 Escalate decisions requiring leadership input
 Qualifications:
 10+ years of experience in program management, project management, or operations, ideally supporting a Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM function
 Strong track record running cross-functional programs with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities
 Experience establishing program governance - operating rhythms, status reporting, decision logs - from scratch
 Comfortable managing risk logs, mitigation plans, and escalation processes
 Excellent communication and facilitation skills; able to align stakeholders across Sales, CS, Marketing, and RevOps
 Data-driven mindset; comfortable defining and tracking success metrics for programs
 Experience with Project Management tools (Jira, Asana, Monday)
 PMP, Agile/Scrum certification, or equivalent experience a plus
 GTM tool implementation a plus
 Project Management tool experience a plus
 Experience in B2B SaaS preferred
 Pay: 
 Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 4: 
 Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $136,500 - $187,660 **
 Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $122,800 - $168,850 **
 Zone 3: All other US locations - $116,000 - $159,500* *
 LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. 
 *Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.

description:

The Account & Platform Integrity Operations team protects OpenAI's ecosystem by ensuring that users, developers, partners, and organizations can access and build on our platform safely and responsibly. The team works across account integrity, fraud prevention, abuse detection, and platform risk to prevent bad actors from exploiting OpenAI's products and developer surfaces.

About the Role - Platform Operations Program Manager
As OpenAI's developer ecosystem expands, we're building the operational foundation to support the next generation of plugins, MCP apps, agent skills, and integrations. As a Platform Operations Program Manager, you'll partner across Product, Engineering, Policy, Legal, Security, and Developer Experience to design the systems and operating models that enable ecosystem growth while maintaining quality, trust, and an exceptional developer experience.
This role requires strong operational judgment, a deep understanding of developer platforms and APIs, empathy for the developer experience, and the ability to translate evolving product, platform, and policy requirements into scalable operational systems.
Location: San Francisco, CA (Hybrid - 3 days in office)
What You'll Do
 - Own the operational processes that help developers bring apps, plugins, and integrations to market, from submission and review through launch, appeals, and ongoing monitoring.

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, Policy, Legal, Security, Developer Experience, and Go-to-Market teams to turn platform goals and requirements into clear, effective operating processes.
 - Lead high-priority partner reviews and escalations, balancing speed to launch with user trust, and consistent standards.

 - Serve as a senior cross-functional partner, using operational expertise and platform insights to help shape product strategy and improve how the ecosystem works.

 - Exercise strong operational judgment and can balance speed, safety, and business priorities when making decisions.
 - Bring structure to ambiguous, cross-functional problems and drive alignment across Product, Engineering, Policy, Legal, Security, and Operations.
 - Think in systems rather than individual cases, identifying recurring patterns and building durable processes instead of one-off solutions.

title: Renewal Operations Manager
description:
At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.
We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:
Primary Responsibilities
● Rhythm of the business: Own the cadence of renewal manager reviews and CS BU leader forecast alignment, through the weekly leadership meeting with the Renewals leader and Finance, to the final vetted Weekly Deck handoff to Rachel.
● Weekly renewal forecasting: Run the end-to-end weekly forecast, pull and refresh the ATR model via the Google Colab notebook, audit and adjust the Forecast Walk with manual Salesforce corrections, push shifts to the week-over-week dashboard, and maintain the FCST Call Calculator so business unit leaders can set their forward-looking quarter and year call.
● Weekly narrative and rhythm commentary (first 90-day priority): Build the "why" behind forecast movements each week, the Rhythm of Business
commentary and the Weekly Narrative feeding the automated weekly forecast update, partnering with Renewals and Sales leaders on account-level shifts. This step has been running ad hoc since the prior owner's departure; restoring it to a sustained weekly cadence is a top early priority for this role.
● Renewal Save program: Own the Renewal Save List, manage save plays and win-back strategies for at-risk accounts, and produce deal write-ups for leadership review.
● Data integrity and linking: Own the ATR model and Forecast Walk, as the source of truth. Resolve linking gaps, debooks, and amendment errors before they reach leadership reporting.
● Forecast tooling ownership: Build and maintain the Google Colab notebook behind the ATR code and the analytics workflow behind the automated weekly forecast update, evolving both as the forecast process changes rather than treating them as fixed infrastructure.
● Cross-functional interlock: Serve as the connective point between Renewals, CS BU leaders, Sales, and Finance on forecast accuracy and quarterly and yearly target line-of-sight. Flag structural gaps, such as the current lack of a formal Sales/Renewals interlock, rather than working around them silently.
Experience & Qualifications
Must-Haves:
● Three to five years in Renewals Operations, Revenue Operations, or a similar GTM operational role, owning a recurring forecasting motion end to end. ● Deep Salesforce fluency for renewal opportunities, quoting, and linking, you know where the data breaks and how to fix it.
● Working fluency in Google Colab (or comparable notebook-based scripting) and Analytics tools, sufficient to maintain and troubleshoot the workflows the forecast depends on, not just consume their output.
● Comfort in a high-pressure, weekly-cadence environment where the forecast is due whether or not the data is clean.
● Strong Excel and Google Sheets modeling for building and maintaining forecast views.
● Clear written communication, turning account shifts and forecast movement into a leadership-ready narrative on a weekly cadence.
Nice-to-Haves:
● ATR or comparable renewal-tracking model experience.
● Experience operating in an operational matrixed reporting structure. Success Measures (First Year)
1. Weekly Rhythm of Business narrative and Weekly Automated Forecast Update restored to a sustained, on-time weekly cadence.
2. Consistent, on-time weekly forecast delivery.
3. Improved linking accuracy and reduced unlinked ATR.
4. A documented save-plays program with tracked outcomes.
5. A named, working Renewals/Sales interlock, if still open at hire.

title: Sales Enablement Program Manager
description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn't work together.
So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions - to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we've embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.
Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes - large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We're building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

 You Will 
 Support ongoing learning initiatives by helping to plan, build, facilitate, and maintain scalable sales enablement content beyond onboarding.

 Collect feedback and track program impact, using data to assess adoption, knowledge retention, and performance improvements.
 Support regional Canada enablement needs, ensuring content is localized and relevant for diverse sales teams across markets.

 4+ years of experience in Sales Enablement, Sales, or Account Management.
 Strong understanding of adult learning theories and experience applying them to training design, content delivery, or knowledge-sharing systems.
 Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with an ability to influence and collaborate across functions and levels.
