title: Senior Clinical Project Associate
description:
The Opportunity: 
As Senior Clinical Project Associate, you will be accountable for providing clinical trial coordination 
support, along with implementing operational plans in accordance with regulatory guidelines and 
ICH/GCP standards. You will be an integrated member of the Relay Tx Clinical Development Operations 
team making key contributions to the execution of clinical trials that will translate Relay's innovative 
science into impactful medicines for patients.
 Your Role: 
 You will support the day-to-day operations of clinical trial execution, with a focus on site start-up, 
study participant enrollment, clinical monitoring, drug supply planning, defining clinical supply 
logistics, GCP and protocol compliance, from the clinical sites, CROs and vendors.
 You will coordinate with the CRO and the Relay Tx Clinical Operations Lead to support planning from 
study initiation through study closure.
 You will maintain study trackers and provide metrics as needed.
 You will review and contribute to key study documents including, but not limited to, informed 
consent forms, case report forms, and study plans.
 You will assist with the preparation and distribution of meeting agendas and minutes as well as 
actively participate in team meetings providing updates on your key responsibilities.
 You will help to ensure the Trial Master File is up-to-date and inspection ready.
 You will support inspection readiness by collaborating with CROs and providing support to clinical 
sites to prepare for and respond to audit/inspection findings conducted by internal QA and external 
regulatory agencies.
 You will actively participate in the development of department initiatives; contribute ideas to
department initiatives that will make a difference to the efficiency and effectiveness of Clinical 
Operations.
 Your Background: 
 You have 2-3 years of experience in clinical trial experience. CRO or Sponsor experience is strongly 
preferred.
 You are familiar with GCP and ICH Guidelines and the application to the conduct of clinical trials
 You are a motivated self-starter who is capable of flourishing in a fast-paced small company 
environment.
 You are a creative problem-solver with excellent communication and public speaking skills.
 You are familiar with MS Office products (MS Project, Excel and Power Point)
 You have strong interpersonal and organizational skills, with a high degree of attention to detail.
 You are pragmatic and able to manage multiple projects and needs effectively
 Estimated Salary Range : [ $69,000 - $99,000 ].
 The range provided above is based on what we believe to be a reasonable estimate for this job at the time of posting. Actual base salary will depend on a number of factors, including but not limited to, a candidate's education, experience, skills and location.
 #BP1
 About Relay Therapeutics 
 Relay Therapeutics is a clinical-stage precision medicines company transforming the drug discovery process with the goal of bringing life-changing therapies to patients. Built on unparalleled insights into protein motion and how this dynamic behavior relates to protein function, we aim to effectively drug protein targets that have previously been intractable, with an initial focus on enhancing small molecule therapeutic discovery in targeted oncology. Our Dynamo platform integrates an array of leading-edge experimental and computational approaches to provide a differentiated understanding of protein structure and motion to drug these targets. We have built a world-class team of leading experts from each of these disciplines, and they are driven by a deep collaboration at every step of our drug discovery process. 
 Our team is equal parts fearless and relentless, with a shared passion for working collaboratively in intellectually stimulating environments. If you're excited by the challenge of putting protein motion at the heart of drug discovery and passionate about making a difference in the lives of patients, join us!

title: Operations Analyst
description:
We're looking for an Operations Analyst to make sure no order gets stuck at our partner pharmacies, so that every treatment is invoiced, compounded, shipped, and integrated within the timeframe and quality standards agreed with the patient. To do this, you'll combine close relationships with pharmacies, data analysis to get to the root cause of problems, and continuous process improvement.
 Responsibilities: 
 Partner Pharmacy Management 
 Serve as Manual's point of contact with partner pharmacies, closely monitoring their production, invoicing, and shipping routines.
 Monitor the order queue and pending issues daily, acting to unblock stalled cases before they impact the patient.
 Track each partner's performance through KPIs (shipping SLA, pending orders, cancellations, non-conformities).
 Build and follow up on action plans with pharmacies, holding them accountable for deadlines and verifying the effectiveness of corrective actions.
 Support compliance with operational and quality agreements (audits, technical visits, documentation, and handling of non-conformities).
 Train pharmacy teams on Manual's new workflows, standards, and tools.
 Support the evaluation and onboarding of new partner pharmacies.
 Data Analysis and Problem Solving 
 Analyze operational data to identify patterns, deviations, and the root cause of delays, cancellations, and recurring failures, going beyond the symptoms.
 Build and maintain reports and controls that give leadership visibility into operations.
 Turn analyses into clear, prioritized recommendations with estimated impact.
 Propose and implement process improvements, standardizing routines and reducing rework.
 Communication with Internal and External Stakeholders 
 Work alongside Customer Experience (CX), Product, Technology, Logistics, and Medical teams to resolve cases and align priorities.
 Handle and follow up on operational tickets (Zendesk), ensuring fast responses and end-to-end resolution.
 Proactively communicate status, risks, and operational changes, anticipating problems rather than reacting to them.
 Maintain active, clear, and frequent communication with partner pharmacies at different levels (operations, quality, and performance).
 Engage with carriers, suppliers, and other partners across the chain to resolve issues affecting delivery to the patient.
 Document agreements, commitments, and decisions to ensure traceability.
 Requirements: 
 Advanced Excel (pivot tables, PROCV/PROCX, SOMASES, handling large datasets).
 Experience with Zendesk or a similar ticketing tool.
 Advanced English for reading, writing, and conversation.
 Clear and assertive communication, both written and verbal, with the ability to hold people accountable for deadlines without straining the relationship.
 Autonomy, personal organization, a strong sense of ownership, and the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced startup environment.

title: Technical Program Manager, Extensibility Platform
description:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
 About our organization 
 The Developer Experience & Product Platform (DEeP) organization empowers all of Stripe's products with a shared product platform that delivers high-quality, consistent, cross-product experiences across our UI and API surfaces. DEeP focuses on providing a scalable developer experience that any developer can leverage to accelerate a customer's ability to create value from Stripe.
 Within DEeP, the Extensibility program is how Stripe expands its total addressable market, and increases customer retention. With extensibility, Stripe becomes programmable - customers and product teams can adapt Stripe to their needs on a common platform.
 Stripe has three interconnected extensibility primitives:
 Scripts - Secure, isolated TypeScript runtime allowing merchants and developers to customize Stripe product behavior (e.g., discount calculations, invoice logic, proration).
 Custom Objects - User-defined data models (e.g., Shipments, Locations, Warranties, Entitlements) with first-class APIs, SDKs, and Dashboard experiences.
 Workflows - A programmable orchestration layer (graduating to GA at Sessions) enabling no-code and pro-code business logic across Stripe, including custom actions, delays, smart retries, and 3P integrations.
 These primitives are deeply interdependent, involve 10+ cross-functional teams and culminate in a flagship product launch.
 What you'll do 
 We are seeking a product-focused Technical Program Manager to drive the Extensibility program across the Workflows, Custom Objects, and Scripts workstreams. This is a newly created, high-impact role at the intersection of platform engineering, product management, and cross-organizational program ownership.
 In this role, you will own one of the most strategically consequential programs in DEeP - driving the direction, health, and outcomes of Stripe's Extensibility platform across Scripts, Custom Objects, and Workflows. You will set the program strategy in partnership with DEeP leadership, holding organizations accountable to the success of the program. 
 Drive cross-org decisions across DRIs in Script Platform, Custom Objects, Apps, SDK, Observability, DevEx, and Versioning - actively resolving the hard, ambiguous integration and ownership questions that fall between team boundaries.
 Own the critical path to major launches - proactively shaping scope, driving descope decisions, and negotiating trade-offs across teams so that launches reflect deliberate strategic choices.
 Influence and shape product and engineering roadmaps - bringing a program-level perspective to team planning cycles, pushing back where individual team roadmaps are misaligned with broader extensibility strategy, and advocating for cross-cutting investments that no single team will prioritize on their own.
 Support ProServ and Partnerships - Ensure ProServ and Partnerships requirements are surfaced into the roadmap with the same rigor as product requirements, and hold the bridge between what the platform delivers and what those teams need to close and serve complex customers.
 Qualifications 
 Minimum requirements 
 5+ years of technical program management experience with demonstrated success in driving complex cross organizational programs.
 Strong product sense and ability to understand enterprise customer needs
 Demonstrated ability to communicate with precision and credibility across engineering, product, and executive audiences, translating complex technical trade-offs into strategic decisions, and driving alignment.
 Demonstrated ability to lead and align cross-functional teams - driving decisions, resolving conflict, and building consensus across organizations with competing priorities
 Proven track record of successful program delivery in complex technical environments
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Background in product management or product operations
 Experience with developer platforms, API products, or payment systems

title: IT Operations Specialist I
description:
About Us
 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world's largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine's Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
 At Cloudflare, we're not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we're looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you're the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you'll fit right in.
 Available Locations: London, UK
 Role summary 
 As an IT Operations Specialist I, you will provide essential onsite IT support and help maintain daily workplace technology at our corporate office. Working in a heavy macOS and Google Workspace environment with additional support for Windows and Linux endpoints, you will deliver hands-on technical assistance, maintain office AV systems, and manage end-to-end hire-to-retire lifecycle processes. In this role, you will also leverage our internal AI technology tools to optimize support workflows and documentation. You will collaborate closely with broader IT teams, the IT Service Desk, HR, Places & Office, and Security teams to ensure a seamless technical experience for all employees.
 Role responsibilities 
 Act as the primary onsite technical support resource, managing employee walk-ups, support tickets, and hardware troubleshooting across macOS, Windows, and Linux endpoints.

 Manage complete hire-to-retire IT operations, including hardware provisioning, account setup, leading IT orientation for new hires, offboarding asset recovery, and access revoking.
 Administer day-to-day user accounts, permissions, and group access within Google Workspace and connected corporate SaaS tools.
 Manage physical IT asset lifecycle operations, including inventory tracking, hardware check-in/check-out, stock audits, and secure device disposal.
 Utilize internal AI technology tools to summarize support incidents, speed up ticket resolution, and draft self-service Knowledge Base (KB) documentation for end users.
 Support office conference room technology (Google Meet Hardware and Zoom Rooms) and provide live technical setup for corporate town halls and department events.
 Participate in a scheduled on-call rotation (evenings and weekends) to address critical after-hours P1/P2 incidents, system outages, and urgent executive support needs.
 This is an in-office/onsite position. This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.
 Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience 
 1-2 years of hands-on IT support or help-desk experience in a corporate environment.
 Strong expertise troubleshooting macOS hardware, software, and enterprise OS configurations.
 Working knowledge of Windows OS and basic Linux desktop administration or CLI troubleshooting.
 Practical administrative experience with Google Workspace (User management, Shared Drives, Groups, Admin Console).
 Willingness and availability to work fully onsite 5 days a week and participate in a scheduled on-call rotation for after-hours support.
 Readiness to utilize internal AI tools and assistants to streamline ticketing, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer-first approach to technical support and leading new-hire orientations.
 Application requires a current resume/CV detailing relevant IT workplace support experience.
 Bonus points 
 Experience with macOS endpoint management using Mobile Device Management (MDM) platforms like Jamf Pro or Kandji.
 Experience using corporate ticketing platforms such as Jira Service Management or Zendesk.
 Relevant technical certifications such as Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP), Google Workspace Administrator, CompTIA A+, or ITIL 4 Foundation.
 Equity 
 This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.
 Benefits 
 Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.
 Health & Welfare Benefits

 Vision Insurance

 Commuter Spending Accounts

 What Makes Cloudflare Special?
 We're not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We're a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. 
 Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare's enterprise customers--at no cost. 
 Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 
 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here's the deal - we don't store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. 
 Sound like something you'd like to be a part of? We'd love to hear from you! 
 Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

title: Compliance Operations Manager
description:
Who We Are
Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building. Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare's greatest needs. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve.
Who You Are
As the Compliance Operations Manager, you support the management and execution of Inovalon's Corporate Compliance Program from India, helping drive consistency, accountability, and strong operational execution across the Legal, Privacy and Compliance function. You coordinate compliance training, vendor oversight, audit support, policy governance, and reporting activities while partnering with stakeholders in both India and the United States. In this role, you strengthen documentation, follow-through, and visibility across key compliance operations that support the broader business and regulatory environment.
What You'll Do
• Provide operational support for the Corporate Compliance Program, including compliance training, vendor oversight, auditing and monitoring, policy governance, compliance documentation, and related activities.
• Support compliance training administration by tracking completion status, preparing follow-up reports, monitoring delinquency trends, maintaining supporting documentation, and coordinating reminders or escalations.
• Manage vendor oversight activities by scheduling and documenting vendor tiering meetings, maintaining tiering trackers, coordinating site audit logistics, collecting audit evidence, and tracking follow-up items through closure.
• Coordinate client, vendor, and third-party audit requests by overseeing documentation and evidence collection, managing deadlines, and following up on outstanding requests and corrective action items.
• Manage compliance program tracking and reporting, including dashboards, status reports, meeting documentation, and other management tools that provide visibility into compliance priorities, activities, and progress.
• Partner with U.S. and India-based stakeholders to support timely information gathering, issue escalation, documentation review, and completion of assigned compliance operations activities.
• Assist with periodic reviews of compliance policies, procedures, and control documents by tracking review cycles, compiling feedback, and maintaining version control and approval documentation.
• Lead the initial preparation of Compliance Committee materials, including drafting agendas, minutes, and follow-up trackers, and coordinating review and finalization with Compliance leadership.
• Identify operational gaps, overdue items, documentation deficiencies, and process inefficiencies, and drive escalation, follow-up, and resolution in coordination with Compliance leadership.
• Maintain awareness of applicable compliance processes and internal requirements to support consistent execution of compliance operations activities.
What You'll Need
• 7+ years of experience in compliance, risk management, legal operations, privacy, audit, or a related field.
• Bachelor's Degree in Arts/Sciences (B.A./B.S.) or commensurate work experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
• Experience managing compliance programs, policies, and internal controls.
• Strong project management and operational excellence skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
• Experience leading compliance investigations, risk assessments, audits, and remediation activities.
• Ability to partner effectively across global, cross-functional teams.
• Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
• Demonstrate growth potential and learning agility by building knowledge of evolving compliance requirements, operational processes, and business needs, and applying that learning to improve execution and program outcomes.
• Demonstrate leadership by influencing cross-functional stakeholders, coordinating work across global teams, and driving accountability, follow-up, and resolution on compliance priorities.
• Demonstrate adaptability by managing shifting priorities, changing deadlines, and emerging compliance needs while maintaining strong execution and documentation quality.
• Demonstrate creative thinking by improving workflows, identifying practical solutions to operational gaps, and strengthening compliance processes, reporting, and oversight activities.
• Demonstrate analytical skills by interpreting trends, identifying deficiencies, assessing operational risks, and using data and evidence to support decisions and escalations.
• Nice to have: Experience in healthcare, healthcare technology, privacy, or other regulated industries; knowledge of HIPAA, GDPR, AI governance, and third-party risk management; experience supporting compliance operations in a global environment; familiarity with governance, risk, and compliance platforms such as OneTrust or similar tools.
Our Shared Commitments
• Maintain compliance with Inovalon's policies, procedures and mission statement;
• Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within Inovalon's Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position; and
• Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by Inovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of Employer.
Work Environment
• This is primarily a computer-based role performed in a remote, hybrid, or office environment. The role requires prolonged periods of computer use and frequent communication and interaction with others, either virtually and/or in person. The role may occasionally require transporting or moving work-related equipment weighing up to 10 pounds, such as a laptop and related materials. Some travel may be required, depending on the needs of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position, consistent with applicable law.
This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e.g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)
If you don't meet every qualification listed but are excited about our mission and the work described, we encourage you to apply. Inovalon is most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and you may be just the right person for this or other roles.
By embracing inclusion, we enhance our work environment and drive business success. Inovalon strives to provide equal opportunities to the communities where we operate and to our clients and everyone whom we serve. We endeavor to create a culture of inclusion in which our associates feel empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work and pursue their professional goals in an equitable setting. We understand that by fostering this type of culture, and welcoming different perspectives, we generate innovation and growth.
Inovalon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirement.

title: Staff Customer Success Manager, Majors (Financial Services)
description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk. 
Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake. 
Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.
 The role, in a nutshell: 
 As a Majors Customer Success Manager at Chainguard, you will serve as the strategic business partner for a select portfolio of our most important financial services customers. You will be the post-sales primary point of contact, responsible for driving outcomes, building executive relationships, and ensuring customers realize measurable value from Chainguard. In this role, you will work closely with Solutions Architects, Technical Support, Product Management, and Sales, with the SA owning technical implementation so you can stay focused on business outcomes, relationship depth, and long-term account health.
 This is a high-touch, consultative role. Your book of business will be intentionally smaller so you can invest deeply in each account, understand each customer's business priorities, and position Chainguard as a strategic partner rather than a vendor.
 What you'll do: 
 Strategic Account Management: Build and maintain trusted relationships across customer organizations, from practitioner teams to CISOs and executive sponsors. Understand each customer's business objectives, risk priorities, and regulatory environment to align Chainguard's value accordingly.
 Customer Onboarding and Success Planning: Lead the business-focused elements of onboarding, including success planning, stakeholder alignment, and value delivery milestones. Partner with Solutions Architects who own technical implementation, ensuring business and technical workstreams stay coordinated.
 Executive Engagement: Lead and facilitate executive business reviews, strategic planning sessions, and escalation conversations. Know when to bring in Chainguard's executive team and how to navigate complex stakeholder dynamics in large financial institutions.
 Renewal and Expansion: Work closely with your sales counterparts to identify expansion opportunities, mitigate renewal risk, and build multi-year account strategies grounded in demonstrated value.
 Customer Advocacy: Represent the voice of the customer internally, translating customer needs into product and roadmap feedback. Influence cross-functional teams including Product, Engineering, and Sales on behalf of your accounts.
 Issue Management: Coordinate with Technical Support and Engineering on escalations, serving as the business-facing lead while the SA manages technical resolution.
 What we're looking for: 
 5+ years in enterprise customer-facing roles, with a strong preference for experience in or adjacent to financial services. Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, or Consulting backgrounds are all relevant.
 Demonstrated ability to operate as a strategic business partner, not just a relationship manager. This means understanding customer business goals, navigating organizational complexity, and connecting Chainguard outcomes to measurable business value.
 Familiarity with financial services regulatory and compliance drivers (SOC 2, FedRAMP, PCI DSS, operational resilience frameworks) and how they shape security buying decisions.
 Working knowledge of one or more of the following domains: software supply chain security, vulnerability management, DevSecOps, container security, or application security. You do not need to be a technical implementer, but you need to speak credibly to business and security outcomes in these areas.
 This is a high-autonomy role. You are expected to take full ownership of your portfolio, make independent decisions about account strategy and escalation, and build new playbooks when existing ones do not fit.
 Strong executive presence and communication skills, both written and verbal.
 High emotional intelligence, strong prioritization instincts, and comfort navigating ambiguity.
 Strongly Preferred: 
 Prior experience managing strategic accounts at a cybersecurity or infrastructure software company
 Experience supporting or selling into financial services customers such as banks, asset managers, insurers, or fintechs
 Familiarity with the security and compliance obligations that shape procurement and adoption cycles in regulated industries
 Previous early-stage startup experience
 If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply . Chainguard is on a mission to build the best team. To achieve our goal, we are focused on hiring Chainguardians with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. 
 Compensation: up to $200K base salary (plus bonus)
 A few of the benefits we offer:
 Equity/stock options
 Unlimited PTO
 Remote work with flexible coworking and team meetup opportunities
 Home office and internet stipend
 100% health/dental/vision insurance coverage for you and your family
 Paid parental leave to support you and your family
 Chainguard is an equal opportunity employer. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.
 By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Chainguard will process your personal data in accordance with Chainguard's Privacy Policy.
 About Us
 We live and breathe our company values:
 We are customer obsessed - We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.
 We have a bias for intentional action - We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.
 We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) - We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.
 We trust each other and assume good intentions - We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.
 A few of the benefits we offer:

 Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).

title: Implementation Manager, Insurance
description:
Hover helps people design, improve, and protect the properties they love. With proprietary AI built on over a decade of real property data, Hover answers age-old questions like “What will it look like?” and “What will it cost?” Homeowners, contractors, and insurance professionals rely on Hover to get fully measured, accurate, and interactive 3D models of any property - all from a smartphone scan in minutes.
 At Hover, we're driven by curiosity, purpose, and a shared commitment to serving our customers, communities, and each other. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives and are proud to cultivate an inclusive, high-performance culture that inspires growth, accountability, and excellence. Backed by leading investors like Google Ventures and Menlo Ventures, and trusted by industry leaders including Travelers, State Farm, and Nationwide - we're redefining how people understand and interact with their spaces.
 Why Hover wants you
 Nine of the top ten U.S. insurance carriers use Hover to turn a policyholder's smartphone scan into an accurate 3D model, so claims move faster and settle with fewer site visits. We're building our Implementation function now, and we want an Implementation Manager who will deliver our most strategic and complex carrier deployments. You'll work with Hover's largest insurance customers, help define and iterate on the implementation playbook as an early member of the team, and see your work change how adjusters and policyholders handle claims. If you like building the process while you deliver, this is the role.
 You will contribute by
 You'll own several enterprise implementations at once, from sales handoff through adoption and transition to Customer Success. You'll lead kickoffs, working sessions, and training with carrier claims teams, and you'll run the plan, status reporting, and risk management that keep rollouts on track. You'll get hands-on with configuration, data migration, integration testing, and UAT, partnering with Solutions Architects on how Hover connects to the insurance ecosystem, including Verisk and Cotality. You'll guide customers through change management as their teams move from in-person inspections to remote, scan-based workflows. Alongside a small team, you'll help build the playbook, templates, and processes every future rollout will use. 
 Lead customer-facing delivery: kickoffs, working sessions, training, and status calls
 Manage project plans, timelines, risk logs, and executive status reporting
 Incorporate implementation learnings into our playbook to refine our ever-evolving process
 Configure the platform and support data migration, integration testing, and UAT
 Coordinate with Sales, Customer Success, Solutions, Product, and Engineering on handoffs and escalations
 Contribute to enablement, process improvement, and the implementation playbook
 Your background includes
 4+ years of direct, hands-on implementation experience at a SaaS company, ideally a high-growth or venture-backed one 
 Experience delivering enterprise implementations, including managing several at the same time
 A track record of building and refining systems, templates, or processes that others adopted
 Experience with configuration, data migration, integrations, and UAT for a workflow-based product
 Strong cross-functional skills, with experience partnering closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering
 Comfort working autonomously at a small-company pace, where you own a lot and priorities can shift
 Clear, confident communication with customer stakeholders, from end users to executives
 Nice-to-haves: 
 Experience with insurance claims products or the insurance technology ecosystem (for example Guidewire, Duck Creek, Verisk, or Cotality)
 Experience driving change management for large customer teams moving to a new workflow
 Experience implementing workflow-based platforms such as ServiceNow, Procore, ServiceTitan, Airtable, monday.com, Ironclad, UiPath, or Celonis
 Benefits
 Compensation - Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a fast-growing company
 Healthcare - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and dependents
 Paid Time Off - Unlimited and flexible vacation policy 
 Paid Family Leave - We support work/life balance and offer generous paid parental and new child bonding leave 
 Mandatory Self-Care Days - A day set aside each month to allow employees to recharge 
 Remote Wellbeing Resources - We provide recurring fitness classes, meditation/ mindfulness tools, virtual therapy, and family planning assistance 
 Learning - We encourage continued education and will help cover the cost of management training, conferences, workshops, or certifications
 Hybrid roles at Hover
 Hover has Hubs in San Francisco and New York City, where we expect that all employees living within a 50-mile radius of our offices will come into their local Hover office at least three times a week to build rapport and foster organic connection. At this time, Hover is not considering fully remote roles.
 The US base salary range for this full-time position is $133,000-$165,000 annually. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all applicable US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

title: Principal, Clinical Product
description:
1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway's mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.
But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.
We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.
ABOUT THE ROLE
As Principal, Clinical Product at Headway, you'll embed behavioral health expertise into the design, governance, and evolution of our digital platform. You will ensure our products are clinically sound, ethically designed, compliant with evolving standards, and aligned with best practices in patient safety and quality.
You will operate at the intersection of clinical care, AI innovation, and product strategy translating complex behavioral health workflows into scalable digital solutions that empower over 80,000 clinicians and millions of patients.
This role requires strong collaboration, leadership skills, clear communication, and the ability to execute both independently and within cross-functional teams. Your work will directly support growing our provider network, connecting more patients to care, and improving patient outcomes.
This role is for a licensed psychiatrist or psychologist who has partnered closely with product and engineering teams to build AI-enabled healthcare tools, and who wants to shape how clinical quality shows up in products at a national scale.
YOU WILL
 - Embed with product teams on our highest-priority initiatives so clinical input shapes the work from problem definition through launch, rather than arriving as a review gate at the end
 - Translate complex clinical workflows into requirements engineers and designers can build against
 - Bring clinical judgment to AI-enabled features, helping teams define what safe, useful, clinically appropriate behavior looks like, and how to evaluate it
 - Help define what clinical quality, patient safety, and good outcomes look like on our platform, and make them measurable
 - Monitor how our products perform across provider adoption, patient experience, and clinical quality, using both data and direct input from clinicians and patients
 - Partner with Data and Analytics to turn ambiguous questions into insight that changes product decisions
 - Align product, design, data, and engineering on clinical tradeoffs and keep decisions moving
YOU'D BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE
 - An active, unrestricted license as a psychologist (PhD/PsyD) or psychiatrist (MD/DO) with 6+ years of post-graduate clinical experience
 - Direct experience partnering with product and engineering teams to build AI-enabled healthcare tools
 - Experience with AI governance, risk frameworks, or clinical safety standards for AI
 - Experience at a high-growth startup or tech company
 - Strong analytical instincts: you can define a metric, defend it, and use data to change a decision
 - Clear communication: you can explain clinical concepts simply to teams without healthcare backgrounds, and influence decisions without formal authority
NICE TO HAVE
 - Background in behavioral health quality or patient safety programs
 - Hands-on work with claims data, outcomes measurement, or measurement-informed care
 - Experience presenting to health plan or health system leadership, or at industry conferences
COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:
The expected base pay range for this position is $170,000 - $280,000, based on a variety of factors including qualifications, experience, and geographic location.
We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential.
Benefits offered include:
 - Equity Compensation
 - Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
 - HSA / FSA
 - 401K
 - Work-from-Home Stipend
 - Therapy Reimbursement
 - 16-week parental leave for eligible employees
 - Carrot Fertility annual reimbursement and membership
 - 13 paid holidays each year as well as a Holiday Break during the week between December 25th and December 31st
 - Flexible PTO
 - Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
 - Training and professional development
We believe a team's strength is in its people, and we cannot achieve this mission without a team that reflects the diversity of this problem - across race, ethnicity, gender, sexuality, age, national origin, religion, family status, disability, military status, and experience. Headway is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Headway will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please inform the recruiter when they contact you to schedule your interview.
Headway participates in E-Verify. To learn more, click here. https://www.e-verify.gov/sites/default/files/everify/posters/EVerifyParticipationPoster.pdf
A notice to Headway applicants: To protect yourself against phishing and recruitment fraud, please note that Headway only accepts applications through our official careers page at https://headway.co/careers. Headway will never refer you to external websites, ask for payment or personal information, or conduct interviews via messaging apps. All official communication will come from a @findheadway.com http://findheadway.com email address. If you are contacted by someone claiming to be from Headway via an unofficial channel, please do not share any information and report it as spam.

title: Senior Group Manager, Customer Success
description:
About Lyra Health
Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra's transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. 
About the Role
Lyra Health is looking for a Senior Group Manager who is energized by engaging with customers, building relationships, and delivering results. Reporting to the Director of Customer Success, you will lead a subset of the team. You should be highly organized, detail-oriented, and resourceful. This role will be a great fit for you if you are a doer, passionate about making a difference, comfortable with ambiguity, and are naturally collaborative.
Responsibilities: Hire, develop, and retain a team of high-performing Customer Success Managers while ensuring operational consistency across customer tiers and segments.
 Partner with the Customer Success Director to monitor team performance, optimize operational procedures, and elevate training or enablement needs.
 Coach Customer Success Managers to maximize member engagement, customer retention, revenue growth, and value actualization through strategic reporting.
 Drive team accountability for core department KPIs, including renewal rates, customer retention, net-new revenue expansion, and customer satisfaction.
 Provide consolidated reporting on team achievements, identifying business risks or macroeconomic trends blocking desired results.
 Lead risk management strategies across assigned segments to address talent, relationship, and revenue risks through cross-functional reviews and account meetings.
 Oversee monthly revenue forecasting, ensuring strategies are deployed to mitigate financial risks and support underperforming accounts.
 Manage executive-level client engagement and high-visibility clinical or operational escalations alongside your team.
 Represent the Customer Success department in late-stage prospect finalist meetings and strategic internal deal reviews.
 Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners across Partnerships, Marketing, Clinical, Product, Analytics, and Workforce Transformation to ensure the voice of the customer is reflected across all business units.
 Manage customer relationships as needed.
Qualifications: 10+ years of work experience in a high-growth, fast-paced environment; experience leading Customer Success or similar teams is preferred
 5+ years of management experience
 Experience in employer-sponsored health benefits space required
 Ability to effectively organize and manage multiple company initiatives and proven ability to positively influence peers
 Excellent listening and communication skills both verbal and written, with an emphasis on quickly gaining trust; can build relationships at all organizational levels both externally and internally. Ability to communicate effectively with senior management
 Experience with tools such as Salesforce and Tableau. Experience with Gainsight is a plus
 Passion for mental health and changing the healthcare landscape

title: Senior Technical Program Manager
location: San Francisco; Toronto; Los Angeles; Denver; Chicago; New York City; Vancouver; Seattle; Austin; Boston; Dallas
description:
Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products - Scribd®, Slideshare®, EverandTM, and Fable - help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise.
CULTURE AT SCRIBD, INC.
We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.
We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.
So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.
This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.
About the team and role 
Welcome to our small but mighty TPM (Technical Program Management) team! We are the driving force that shapes how our company plans, prioritizes, and executes. As a Senior TPM, you will own program strategy and execution across our marketing organization, which owns two key pillars of work: Customer Operations and Brand Marketing.
Customer Operations is the pillar that reflects the voice of the customer back to the company, and the one that works to deliver an effortless customer support experience. You will partner with its leadership to drive the programs that connect that work to the rest of the company, from the voice of the customer program, to how that support experience is designed and delivered end to end, to the evolution of the operational model and team structure for Premium support.
Brand Marketing is the pillar that helps the company build and sustain brands people love and want to tell their friends about. You will act as the connector between brand strategy and product strategy and execution, working across stakeholders to design the processes, workflows, and tools that make sure the personality and identity of our brands are felt in the product itself and in our messaging and communications, which include larger brand campaigns as well as always-on communications.
You will drive the roadmap across both, connect them to the teams and leaders that depend on them, and bring a builder's instinct to the work, using AI and creative workflows to design better ways of running these programs.
About you 
You are a thoughtful opinionator: you hold strong, well-reasoned views and are capable of voicing them respectfully to anyone, at any level. You are a proactive communicator who identifies possible problems before they surface.
You are a relationship builder and organizational navigator at heart, adept at building bridges across teams and functions. You are comfortable working with customer experience, marketing, and creative teams as well as product and engineering, able to follow the substance and hold your own with the subject matter experts you partner with.
You care about customers and about the power of building strong brands. You understand what a great customer experience is worth to a company, and you are intellectually curious about how brand personality and identity show up in consumer-facing products. You have been part of efforts that connected brand strategy to how a product is built and experienced.
You are already working with AI, and you have a point of view on where the TPM craft is headed in an increasingly agentic world. You have changed how you operate because of it.
You are a continuous learner with a growth mindset and an appetite for unfamiliar problems. Lastly, you are a voracious reader with a passion for books and the written and spoken word in all its forms!
What you will do
 - Act like an owner: Be an owner of program strategy and execution across our Customer Operations and Brand Marketing pillars, and serve as the connective tissue between those pillars and the partners they depend on.
 - Build relationships: Our TPM team thrives on collaboration. You will work closely with stakeholders at every level, from customer experience and marketing teams to engineers and executives, and your ability to build trust and align diverse perspectives will be central to what you can accomplish.
 - Drive strategy: You will dive deep into the how and the why of your programs, developing plans that connect day-to-day execution to where these pillars need to go. Your judgment will shape how decisions get made.
 - Decide what's worth doing: Partner with Customer Operations leadership to prioritize projects by customer impact, weigh them against team capacity, and defer or decline the rest. The customer's experience stays at the center of every tradeoff.
 - Connect marketing and product: Act as a connector between our marketing organization and our product-centric teams, working across stakeholders to design the processes, workflows, and tools that make sure brand is part of our key releases, in the product experience itself and in the messaging and communications around it.
 - Be a leader: Act as a leader within the TPM team. Identify opportunities to collaborate, share what works, and coach your teammates.
 - Lead beyond your pillars: Our TPM team also owns cross-company processes like yearly planning. You will contribute to these shared efforts and take a leadership role in shaping them.
 - Own the complexity: Drive multiple complex cross-functional programs simultaneously, and create scalable frameworks across pillars and functions to track work and communicate progress.
 - Enable your drivers: Many of the people driving and contributing to Customer Operations initiatives are also handling day to day frontline work and escalations. You will plan around their real capacity and give them structure and support, rather than assigning tasks and chasing updates.
 - Manage timelines: Lead the delivery timeline for your programs. Proactively identify risks and create mitigation strategies through workflows, communication, or resource allocation.
 - Measure success: Proactively propose success metrics for yourself and your programs, and identify when those metrics are at risk.
 - Build to move faster: Use AI and lightweight tooling to reduce the coordination tax on your teams. When you spot a manual, repetitive process, build something better.
 - Improve how we work: Identify and drive process improvements at the team and cross-team level, so the whole organization delivers at a larger scale.
We're looking for
 - 5+ years of experience in a program management, operations, or equivalent role at a technology company.
 - A track record of operating independently, leading through ambiguity, and navigating complex organizational dynamics.
 - A structured approach to your work, paired with the judgment to know when to add process and when to remove it to reduce overhead and drive velocity.
 - Experience partnering closely with customer operations, marketing, or brand teams, and connecting their work to product and engineering teams.
 - An understanding of what great customer support is worth to a brand, and enough knowledge of brand to hold your own with marketers. You have worked with customer support teams, or know their workflows well enough to be a useful partner to them.
 - A customer-first lens in how you make decisions, with the judgment to weigh customer impact against efficiency.
 - Experience rolling out operational changes, such as process and tooling to a frontline team.
 - Strong familiarity with the software development process, working with product and engineering teams from roadmapping through delivery.
 - Experience working directly with product managers, engineers, marketers, and other subject matter experts.
 - Hands-on experience using AI in your work, and a clear point of view on how it changes the program management craft. You have already adjusted how you operate because of it.
 - Experience using data to identify problems and communicate solutions.
 - The ability to work and partner successfully across multiple functions in an organization.
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
 - Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to understand and articulate the big picture.
 - Distinctive problem-solving and analytical skills.
Bonus Points
 - You have held a program management role at a company where customer support sits at the heart of the brand.
 - You have seen up close how great customer support works, even if you have not worked in it directly.
 - You have run or helped run brand campaigns.
 - You have worked in a brand or marketing role earlier in your career.
 - You have designed AI workflows that enable customer operations or brand marketing teams to do their best work, whether that meant changing how a team handles its day-to-day or building something foundational they now can't imagine working without.

title: Marketing Operations Manager — Funnel & Lifecycle
description:
Who We Are 
 At Justworks, you'll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people. 
 We're helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We're data-driven and never stop iterating. If you'd like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we'd love to hear from you. 
 We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team. 
 Our Values 
 If this sounds like you, you'll fit right in. 
 About the role 
 Justworks is building a connected go-to-market operating model across a multi-product platform with self-service, hybrid, partner, and managed-sales motions.
 The Marketing Operations Manager - Funnel & Lifecycle will own the operational processes, data requirements, and business rules that help prospects and customers move through the right journey at the right time.
 You will partner with Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Customer Success to translate their strategies into effective intake, enrichment, scoring, routing, segmentation, nurture eligibility, and lifecycle triggers. You will use data and AI to help these teams make better decisions and identify where prospects and customers are getting stuck or overlooked.
 This is a hands-on individual-contributor role. You will work closely with Campaign Operations to turn journey requirements into coordinated execution, and with GTM Technology and Analytics to ensure the underlying systems and measurement support those journeys.
 What you'll do 
 Map and improve prospect and customer journeys across products, channels, and self-service, hybrid, partner, and managed-sales paths.
 Own lead-management processes including intake, enrichment, qualification, scoring, routing, handoffs, recycling, and re-engagement.
 Partner with Marketing and other GTM teams to define how customer needs, behaviors, and signals should inform the next action.
 Translate agreed strategies into audience definitions, eligibility criteria, scoring models, routing rules, lifecycle triggers, and suppression policies.
 Define operational requirements for nurture, abandoned applications, closed-lost re-engagement, onboarding, adoption, retention, and cross-sell programs.
 Partner with Campaign Operations to implement, test, and monitor those journeys across execution platforms.
 Establish clear rules for ownership, response expectations, stage progression, contact frequency, exceptions, and handoffs between teams.
 Identify funnel leakage, stalled journeys, conflicting outreach, and gaps in follow-up, then coordinate improvements.
 Partner with GTM Technology to address data quality, enrichment, integrations, and event or signal requirements.
 Partner with GTM Planning & Analysis to measure conversion, journey progression, routing accuracy, speed to lead, and handoff quality.
 Use AI and experimentation to improve prioritization, segmentation, decision-making, and exception detection.
 Maintain documentation, monitoring, and governance so journey rules remain reliable as the business evolves.
 What you'll bring 
 6+ years of experience in marketing operations, revenue operations, lifecycle operations, growth operations, or a related function.
 Experience supporting a multi-product B2B technology business with both self-service or product-led and sales-assisted motions.
 Strong knowledge of lead management, scoring, routing, segmentation, nurture, and lifecycle orchestration.
 Experience translating business strategies into operational rules across CRM, marketing automation, and customer-engagement platforms.
 Comfort working with firmographic, behavioral, product-usage, engagement, and customer data.
 Strong analytical judgment and the ability to identify why prospects or customers are failing to progress.
 A track record of improving processes across teams and systems.
 Excellent cross-functional partnership skills and the ability to build agreement around shared decisions.
 Practical experience using AI and automation to improve GTM operations.
 What success looks like 
 Prospects and customers enter appropriate journeys and receive timely, relevant follow-up.
 Routing, handoffs, nurture eligibility, and lifecycle rules are clear, accurate, and trusted.
 Fewer prospects and customers are lost, stalled, misrouted, or exposed to conflicting outreach.
 Marketing and GTM teams use shared journey definitions and have visibility into where improvements are needed.
 Journey improvements contribute to stronger conversion, adoption, retention, and expansion.
 The base wage range for this position based in our New York City Office is targeted at $121,000.00 to $151,000.00 per year. This role is required to work a hybrid schedule including 2 days a week from our office at 55 Water Street, in New York City. 
 #LI-BF1 
 #LI-Hybrid 
 Actual compensation is based on multiple factors that are unique to each candidate, including and not limited to skill set, level of relevant experience, and specific work location. Salary ranges for positions based in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location. 
 For more information about Justworks' Total Reward Philosophy, including all of the perks and benefits we are proud to offer our team members, please visit Total Rewards @ Justworks . 
 Diversity At Justworks 
 Justworks is committed to maintaining a workplace where diversity of identity, culture, and life experience is the norm and is celebrated authentically and respected consistently. title: GTM Enablement Program Manager - Solutions & Product
description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world's best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform-we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention-but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers. 
When you join one of our teams, you'll be part of a nimble group that's empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won't have to look to find growth opportunities-ready or not, they'll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we're on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that's work worth doing.
 GTM Enablement Program Manager - Solutions & Product 
 Why We Have This Role 
 Sitting within the Chief Sales Officer (CSO) organization with a broad mandate across all Go-To-Market (GTM) functions, our Enablement team owns global onboarding, skill development, and ongoing education for every role touching the customer lifecycle, from SDRs and Account Executives to Solution Engineers and Services. Our team thinks globally for scale, delivering learner-centric enablement experiences that drive full-funnel revenue growth, adoption, customer retention, and operational excellence.
 This role requires a seasoned enablement practitioner who views program and project management as core disciplines to drive real business impact. As the GTM Enablement Program Manager for Solutions & Product, you will act as the strategic architect connecting Product Management, Product Marketing, and our global GTM organization. You won't just coordinate schedules or manage timelines, you will design structured learning journeys, translate complex platform and AI capabilities into field-ready playbooks, and measure the direct line between enablement execution and revenue outcomes.
 How You'll Find Success 
 Enablement Craft & Discipline: You are a proven enablement practitioner who knows how to build end-to-end enablement strategies, design modern learning journeys, and apply adult learning methodologies that actually change behavior.
 Business-Impact Mindset: You understand that great enablement isn't measured by course completion rates, but by ramp time, win rates, pipeline velocity, adoption, and revenue.
 Cross-GTM Perspective: You design targeted enablement tailored across the entire customer lifecycle, recognizing the distinct needs of SDRs (prospecting), AEs (closing), SEs (technical validation), and Services (adoption, value realization, and expansion).
 Technical-to-Value Translator: You turn complex product and platform architectures, enterprise data capabilities, and applied AI into clear, persona-aligned business value that sellers can communicate and customers can realize.
 Rigorous Execution: You leverage strong program and project management capabilities as an essential skill to keep complex, multi-stakeholder product launches and global learning programs running smoothly on schedule.
 How You'll Grow 
 Master Experience Management (XM) as a category, developing deep technical and strategic expertise across platform architectures, enterprise data integration, and AI innovation.
 Gain broad visibility across the entire GTM executive leadership team, shaping programs that directly impact both new business acquisition (ARR) and net revenue retention (NRR).
 Learn how enterprise buyers across various industries (Healthcare, Financial Services, Retail, Public Sector) evaluate, purchase, and extract value from Data and AI solutions.
 Help shape our global Product & Solution Enablement framework and establish scalable standards for product rollouts, technical certifications, and persona-based messaging.
 Things You'll Do 
 Design Learning Journeys: Build structured, multi-modal learning paths and field playbooks for core platform releases, data capabilities, and AI-driven solution features.
 Enable the Full GTM Engine: Map product capabilities to role-specific behaviors: equipping SDRs on pain-point messaging, AEs on value-based discovery, SEs on technical architecture/demo execution, and Services on platform adoption, value realization, and expansion.
 Cross-Functional Orchestration: Partner with Product, PMM, and GTM Leadership to translate product roadmaps into business-ready GTM launches and field certifications.
 Facilitate & Certify: Deliver high-impact interactive workshops, demo practice sessions, and knowledge checks in person and virtually that build field confidence and certified fluency.
 Drive Strategic Program Management: Apply disciplined project management capabilities to manage workstreams, keep multi-stakeholder initiatives on track, and ensure consistent global delivery.
 Measure Business Outcomes: Analyze enablement data against full-lifecycle GTM metrics (e.g., ramp velocity, win rates, demo conversion, multi-product adoption, and NRR) to prove ROI and iterate continuously.
 What We're Looking For On Your Resume 
 4-7+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in sales enablement, technical enablement, or GTM learning design within an enterprise SaaS, Data, or platform environment. .
 Proven track record as an enablement practitioner, demonstrated ability to build end-to-end enablement plans, design adult learning journeys, and measure business impact.
 Working knowledge or functional expertise in SaaS platform architectures, enterprise data integration/analytics, and applied AI capabilities.
 Experience enabling multi-role GTM teams (SDR, AE, SE, CSM, AM) on persona-based selling, industry alignment, and technical solution messaging.
 Strong program management capability used as a discipline to execute complex, multi-stakeholder enablement initiatives on schedule.
 Exemplary cross-functional stakeholder management skills-ability to partner effectively across Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing leadership.
 Experience delivering dynamic training experiences in person and virtually, with facilitation skills that drive field engagement.
 Preferred Qualifications
 Prior background in field enablement, pre-sales (Solution Engineering), Customer Success, or Product Marketing.
 Formal background or certifications in curriculum development, adult learning methodologies, or sales methodologies.
 Experience in or knowledge of Market Research, Customer Experience (CX), and/or Employee Experience (EX).
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
 What You Should Know About This Team 
 Broad purview: While reporting into the CSO, we serve the full GTM organization globally across pre-sale and post-sale functions.
 Direct business impact: Our work directly influences win rates, deal size, multi-product adoption, time-to-value, and net revenue retention (NRR).
 Strong focus on professional development: We invest heavily in your growth, skill-building, and career trajectory.
 High-trust culture: We work hard, innovate constantly, and support each other in a collaborative, high-energy environment.
 Our Team's Favorite Perks and Benefits 
 Competitive salary, performance bonuses, generous 401(k) Match
 Wellness Reimbursement for $300 per quarter for wellness activities including gym memberships, spa massages, workout equipment, meditation apps, and much more.
 $1800 Experience bonus to be used for an “Experience” of your choosing
 Unlimited Sick Days
 Amazing QGroup Communities; MOSAIQ, Green Team, Qualtrics Pride, Q&Able, Qualtrics Salute, and Women's Leadership Development, which exist as places for support, allyship, and advocacy.
 The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model : Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #hybrid
 Qualtrics is an equal opportunity employer meaning that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic. 
 ​​​​​​​Applicants in the United States of America have rights under Federal Employment Laws: Family & Medical Leave Act , Equal Opportunity Employment , Employee Polygraph Protection Act 
 Qualtrics is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Qualtrics will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know.

No spam - we promise! You'll hear from us two times a month max with fresh, totally tailored info - so be sure to stay connected as you explore your best role and company fit.

A sign-on bonus and restricted stock units may be included in an employment offer. Full-time employees are eligible for medical, dental, vision, life and disability, 401(k) with match, paid time off, a wellness reimbursement, mental health benefits, and an experience bonus. For a detailed look at our benefits, visit Qualtrics US Benefits .
